name: SWSE HD
author: Johnson Michaels
description: HD texture pack: 960 textures upscaled to 2x, swapped in by the SWSE DLL at GPU upload. The game's archives are never modified. The textures are a separate download (GitHub Releases or Discord); unzip them into the textures subfolder here, and run SWSE_4GB_Patcher.exe once so the 32-bit game has room for them. NOTE: this folder is runtime data read directly by the SWSE DLL. Turn it on or off in SWSEMods/features.txt, not in the load order.
